title: Add termal_followup_session MCP tool — send a follow-up message to an existing delegation child
outcome:
New TermAl delegation MCP tool (user request). Lets a parent send a follow-up turn to an EXISTING
delegation child instead of spawning a fresh session, so the child keeps its context.

Signature:
  termal_followup_session({
    delegationId,   // required — an existing parent-scoped delegation id
    message         // required — the follow-up prompt to run as a new turn in that child
  })

WHY: today the only delegation tools are spawn / status / result / cancel / resume_after_delegations
(src/delegation_mcp.rs:268-273). After a delegation completes there is no way to ask the same child a
follow-up — you must spawn a new session and lose its context. This adds that.

IMPLEMENTATION ANCHORS (src/delegation_mcp.rs):
 - Add dispatch arm in handle_tool_call (near line 268): "termal_followup_session" => self.tool_followup_session(arguments).
 - Register the tool + JSON schema in the tools/list response (same place the other termal_* tools are advertised).
 - Implement tool_followup_session: resolve delegationId -> child session id (parent-scoped, must still
   exist), then deliver `message` as a new prompt/turn to that child — reuse the existing session
   message route (POST /api/sessions/{id}/messages, the same path spawn/telegram forwarding use) rather
   than inventing a new one. Re-arm the delegation to running so the parent can wait again.
 - Result retrieval reuses the existing tools with the SAME delegationId: termal_resume_after_delegations
   (mode all/any) then termal_get_session_result / termal_get_session_status. No new wait primitive.

DESIGN DECISIONS TO RESOLVE:
 - Child currently running a turn: queue the message behind the active turn (consistent with the
   session pending-prompt queue) vs reject with a clear error. Prefer queue.
 - Child no longer exists / was cancelled or reaped: return a clear MCP error, do not silently spawn.
 - Slash-command resolution: should `message` resolve agent slash-commands like spawn's `prompt` does
   (resolve_spawn_prompt_if_agent_command, delegation_mcp.rs:316) or be delivered literally? Decide and
   document.
 - Write policy / mode: the follow-up runs in the child's EXISTING policy; do not accept new policy args.
 - Delegation status/revision bump so termal_get_session_status reflects the re-run.

TESTS: add to src/tests/delegations.rs — happy path (followup delivers + delegation re-arms + result
retrievable via resume/get_result), unknown/cancelled delegationId error, and queued-behind-active-turn
behavior. Note: this is the user's minimal spec; confirm the queue-vs-reject and slash-resolution
choices before implementing.
